source.text: מִזְמ֡וֹרשִׁ֤ירוּ לַֽיהוָ֨ה׀שִׁ֣יר חָ֭דָשׁ כִּֽי־נִפְלָא֣וֹת עָשָׂ֑ה הוֹשִֽׁיעָה־לּ֥וֹ יְ֝מִינ֗וֹ וּזְר֥וֹעַ קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: A psalm. Sing to YHWH a new song, for wonders he has done; his right hand and his holy arm have won victory for him.

en.L: A psalm. \q Sing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} a new song, for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has done wonders; \q {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} right hand and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy arm have won victory for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: A psalm. \q Sing {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} a new song because of the wonders {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has done! \q By {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own right hand and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy arm {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has won the victory.
en.R: A song. \q Sing a new song to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has done amazing things! \q With {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own power and holy strength {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has won the victory.

fr.L: Un psaume. \q Chantez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} un cantique nouveau, car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait des merveilles ; \q {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} droite et {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} bras saint {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ont donné la victoire.
fr.B: Un psaume. \q Chantez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} un chant nouveau pour les merveilles qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a faites ! \q Par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} propre main droite et par {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} bras saint, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a remporté la victoire.
fr.R: Un chant. \q Chantez un chant nouveau {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, parce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait des choses extraordinaires ! \q Par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} propre puissance et {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} force sainte, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a remporté la victoire.

sw.L: Zaburi. \q Mwimbieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wimbo mpya, kwa maana ametenda maajabu; \q mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wa kuume na mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mtakatifu vimempatia ushindi.
sw.B: Zaburi. \q Mwimbieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wimbo mpya kwa sababu ya maajabu aliyoyatenda! \q Kwa mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wa kuume na mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mtakatifu amepata ushindi.
sw.R: Wimbo. \q Mwimbieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wimbo mpya, kwa sababu ametenda mambo ya ajabu! \q Kwa nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} mwenyewe na uweza {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mtakatifu amepata ushindi.

es.L: Salmo. \q {{plural_you:Canten|Cantad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} un cántico nuevo, porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha hecho maravillas; \q {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} diestra y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santo brazo {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} han dado la victoria.
es.B: Salmo. \q ¡{{plural_you:Canten|Cantad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} un cántico nuevo por las maravillas que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha hecho! \q Con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propia diestra y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santo brazo {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha ganado la victoria.
es.R: Canto. \q ¡{{plural_you:Canten|Cantad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} una canción nueva, porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha hecho cosas asombrosas! \q Con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propio poder y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santa fuerza {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha ganado la victoria.

vi.L: [Một] thi thiên. \q Hãy hát cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} một bài ca mới, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm những việc lạ lùng; \q tay phải {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và cánh tay thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đem chiến thắng về cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Thi thiên. \q Hãy hát cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} một bài ca mới vì những việc diệu kỳ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm! \q Bằng chính tay phải và cánh tay thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã giành chiến thắng.
vi.R: Bài ca. \q Hãy hát một bài ca mới cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm những việc kỳ diệu! \q Bằng chính quyền năng và sức mạnh thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chiến thắng.

ko.L: 시. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 새 노래로 노래하여라. 그분께서 기적들을 행하셨다. \q 그분의 오른손과 그분의 거룩한 팔이 그분께 승리를 가져다주었다.
ko.B: 시. \q 그분께서 행하신 놀라운 일들 때문에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 새 노래를 불러라! \q 그분께서 손수 그 오른손과 거룩한 팔로 승리를 거두셨다.
ko.R: 노래. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 새 노래를 불러라. 그분께서 놀라운 일들을 하셨다! \q 그분께서 자신의 힘과 거룩한 능력으로 승리를 거두셨다.

pt.L: Salmo. \q Cantem {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} um cântico novo, porque {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez maravilhas; \q a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} mão direita e o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} santo braço {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} deram a vitória.
pt.B: Salmo. \q Cantem {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} um cântico novo, por causa das maravilhas que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez! \q Com a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} própria mão direita e o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} santo braço {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} conquistou a vitória.
pt.R: Uma canção. \q Cantem uma canção nova {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez coisas incríveis! \q Com o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} próprio poder e a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} santa força {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} conquistou a vitória.

am.L: መዝሙር። \q {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} አዲስ መዝሙር ዘምሩ፤ ድንቅ ነገሮችን አድርጓልና፤ \q ቀኝ እጁና ቅዱስ ክንዱ ድልን አስገኙለት።
am.B: መዝሙር። \q ስላደረጋቸው ድንቅ ነገሮች {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} አዲስ መዝሙር ዘምሩ! \q በገዛ ቀኝ እጁና በቅዱስ ክንዱ ድል አድርጓል።
am.R: መዝሙር። \q አስደናቂ ነገሮችን ስላደረገ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} አዲስ መዝሙር ዘምሩ! \q በገዛ ኃይሉና በቅዱስ ብርታቱ ድል አድርጓል።

hi.L: भजन। \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए नया गीत गाओ, क्योंकि उन्होंने आश्चर्यकर्म किए हैं; \q उनके दाहिने हाथ और उनकी पवित्र भुजा ने उनके लिए विजय पाई है।
hi.B: भजन। \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए एक नया गीत गाओ, उन आश्चर्यकर्मों के कारण जो उन्होंने किए हैं! \q अपने ही दाहिने हाथ और अपनी पवित्र भुजा से उन्होंने विजय पाई है।
hi.R: गीत। \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए एक नया गीत गाओ, क्योंकि उन्होंने अद्भुत काम किए हैं! \q अपनी ही शक्ति और पवित्र सामर्थ्य से उन्होंने विजय पाई है।

ru.L: Псалом. \q Пойте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}} новую песнь, ведь {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} сотворил чудеса; \q {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} правая рука и {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} святая рука доставили {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}} победу.
ru.B: Псалом. \q Пойте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}} новую песнь за чудеса, которые {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} совершил! \q Своей правой рукой и святой рукой {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} одержал победу.
ru.R: Песнь. \q Пойте новую песню {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, потому что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} совершил удивительные дела! \q Своей силой и святым могуществом {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} одержал победу.

uk.L: Псалом. \q Співайте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}} нову пісню, бо {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} учинив чудеса; \q {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} правиця і {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} святе рамено здобули {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}} перемогу.
uk.B: Псалом. \q Заспівайте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}} нову пісню за дива, які {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} учинив! \q Своєю власною правицею і своїм святим раменом {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} здобув перемогу.
uk.R: Пісня. \q Заспівайте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}} нову пісню, бо {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} зробив дивовижні речі! \q Своєю власною силою і святою могутністю {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} здобув перемогу.

decisions.reason: This psalm's title is one word, "A psalm", and the Hebrew counts it together with the first line as verse 1, so here the verse numbers are the same as in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: psalm: a song sung to music
decisions.reason: The word (mizmor) is a song sung with instruments. It is the only psalm in Psalms 93-99 with a title.

decisions.choice: his right hand and holy arm have won victory for him: he won by his own power
decisions.reason: The hand and arm stand for strength. God won the victory alone, with no one to help (Isaiah 59:16; 63:5), as at the sea (Exodus 15:6). The verb (hoshia') is "save, give victory".
The psalm opens like Psalm 96 and ends like it (98:9 and 96:13).

decisions.choice: his own power and holy strength
alternatives: his right hand and his holy arm
decisions.reason: Readable says what the hand and arm stand for (m3).

decisions.choice: Cantem ao SENHOR um cântico novo (L, B); Cantem uma canção nova ao SENHOR (R)
decisions.reason: The psalm opens as Psalm 96:1 does (m4), so each level repeats that verse's Portuguese.
The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the English setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic; the Amharic text has no deity_pronoun spans.

decisions.choice: the title "A psalm" (mizmor) as "መዝሙር" at every level, and "a new song" as "አዲስ መዝሙር"
decisions.reason: The heading word follows the Psalms terms list. "A new song" keeps the words of the Amharic New Testament at Revelation 5:9 and 14:3 ("አዲስ መዝሙር"), so the song of the Lamb is heard as the same new song.

decisions.choice: "भजन" (L, B), "गीत" (R); "... के लिए नया गीत गाओ" as Psalm 96:1
decisions.reason: The one-word title is "भजन" at Literal and Balanced and "गीत" at Readable, as the poetry note's table has it (meaning m2). The psalm opens like Psalm 96 (meaning m4), so the call to sing a new song keeps the Hindi of 96:1 at each level; the wonders are "आश्चर्यकर्म" (L, B) as in 96:3.

decisions.choice: "Псалом" (L, B), "Песнь" (R); "Пойте ГОСПОДУ новую песнь" as Psalm 96:1
decisions.reason: The title follows the poetry note's table for mizmor; the call to sing a new song keeps the wording of Psalm 96:1 (m4).
Zeroa' is the arm; Russian "рука" serves for hand and arm, as Psalm 44:4 has it, and the Slavonic "мышца" is not used.

source.text: הוֹדִ֣יעַ יְ֭הוָה יְשׁוּעָת֑וֹ לְעֵינֵ֥י הַ֝גּוֹיִ֗ם גִּלָּ֥ה צִדְקָתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH has made known his salvation; before [the] eyes of the nations he has revealed his righteousness.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has made known {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} salvation; \q before the eyes of the nations {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has revealed {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} righteousness.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has let {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} saving power be known; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has shown {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} justice openly for the nations to see.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has shown everyone how {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} saves. \q He has let the nations see that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} does what is right.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a fait connaître {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} salut ; \q aux yeux des nations {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a révélé {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} justice.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a fait connaître {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} puissance qui sauve ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a montré {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} justice au grand jour, sous les yeux des nations.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a montré à tous comment {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} sauve. \q Il a laissé les nations voir qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fait ce qui est juste.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ameufanya wokovu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} ujulikane; \q mbele ya macho ya mataifa ameifunua haki {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ameufanya uweza {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wa kuokoa ujulikane; \q ameionyesha haki {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} wazi mataifa yaone.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amewaonyesha wote jinsi anavyookoa. \q Ameyaacha mataifa yaone kwamba {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} hutenda yaliyo ya haki.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha dado a conocer {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} salvación; \q ante los ojos de las naciones ha revelado {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} justicia.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha hecho conocer {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} poder para salvar; \q ha mostrado abiertamente {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} justicia para que la vean las naciones.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} les ha mostrado a todos cómo {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} salva. \q Ha dejado que las naciones vean que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} hace lo que es justo.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã làm cho [người ta] biết sự cứu rỗi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q trước mắt các dân tộc, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã bày tỏ sự công chính của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã cho biết quyền năng giải cứu của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã tỏ công lý của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ra cho các dân tộc thấy.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã cho mọi người thấy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giải cứu thế nào. \q Ngài đã cho các dân tộc thấy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm điều ngay thẳng.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 구원을 알리셨고, \q 민족들의 눈앞에 그분의 의를 드러내셨다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 구원하시는 능력을 알게 하시고, \q 민족들이 보는 앞에서 그분의 의를 드러내셨다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 모든 사람에게 그분이 어떻게 구원하시는지 보여 주셨다. \q 그분께서 옳은 일을 하신다는 것을 민족들이 보게 하셨다.

pt.L: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} fez conhecida a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} salvação; \q diante dos olhos das nações {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} revelou a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} justiça.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} deu a conhecer o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} poder de salvar; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} mostrou abertamente a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} justiça, para as nações verem.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} mostrou a todos como {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} salva. \q Ele deixou as nações verem que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} faz o que é certo.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ማዳኑን አስታወቀ፤ \q በሕዝቦች ዓይን ፊት ጽድቁን ገለጠ።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የማዳን ኃይሉን አሳወቀ፤ \q ሕዝቦች እንዲያዩ ጽድቁን በግልጽ አሳየ።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዴት እንደሚያድን ለሰው ሁሉ አሳየ። \q ትክክል የሆነውን እንደሚያደርግ ሕዝቦች እንዲያዩ አደረገ።

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने अपना उद्धार प्रकट किया है; \q जातियों की आँखों के सामने उन्होंने अपनी धार्मिकता प्रगट की है।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने अपनी उद्धार करनेवाली शक्ति को प्रकट होने दिया है; \q उन्होंने अपना न्याय खुलेआम दिखाया है ताकि देश-देश के लोग उसे देखें।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने सबको दिखाया है कि वे कैसे उद्धार करते हैं। \q उन्होंने देशों को यह देखने दिया है कि वे वही करते हैं जो सही है।

ru.L: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} дал знать своё спасение; \q перед глазами народов {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} открыл свою праведность.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} показал свою спасающую силу; \q {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} открыто явил свою справедливость на глазах у народов.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} показал всем, как {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} спасает. \q Он дал народам увидеть, что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} поступает справедливо.

uk.L: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} виявив своє спасіння; \q на очах народів {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} відкрив свою праведність.
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} дав пізнати свою спасенну силу; \q {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} відкрито показав народам свою справедливість.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} показав усім, як {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} рятує. \q Він дав народам побачити, що {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} чинить правильно.

decisions.reason: The two words (yeshu'ah, tsedaqah) are paired as in Isaiah 46:13 and 51:5-6: God puts things right by rescuing his people, and the nations see it.
Verses 2-3 echo Isaiah 52:10, where the LORD bares his holy arm before the eyes of all the nations.

source.text: זָ֘כַ֤ר חַסְדּ֨וֹ׀וֶֽאֱֽמוּנָתוֹ֮ לְבֵ֪ית יִשְׂרָ֫אֵ֥ל רָא֥וּ כָל־אַפְסֵי־אָ֑רֶץ אֵ֝֗ת יְשׁוּעַ֥ת אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: He has remembered his loyal love and his faithfulness to [the] house of Israel; all [the] ends of [the] earth have seen the salvation of our God.

en.L: He has remembered {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} faithfulness to the house of Israel; \q all the ends of the earth have seen \q the salvation of our God.
en.B: He has kept in mind {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love and faithfulness toward the people of Israel; \q the farthest places on earth have seen \q how our God saves.
en.R: He has not forgotten {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} faithful love for the people of Israel, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has kept {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} promises to them. \q People in the farthest places on earth have seen \q our God save us.

fr.L: Il s’est souvenu de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour loyal et de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} fidélité envers la maison d’Israël ; \q toutes les extrémités de la terre ont vu \q le salut de notre Dieu.
fr.B: Il n’a pas oublié {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle et {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} fidélité envers le peuple d’Israël ; \q les lieux les plus lointains de la terre ont vu \q comment notre Dieu sauve.
fr.R: Il n’a pas oublié {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle pour le peuple d’Israël, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a tenu {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} promesses envers eux. \q Les gens des endroits les plus lointains de la terre ont vu \q notre Dieu nous sauver.

sw.L: Ameukumbuka upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma na uaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} kwa nyumba ya Israeli; \q miisho yote ya dunia imeuona \q wokovu wa Mungu wetu.
sw.B: Ameukumbuka upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma na uaminifu kwa watu wa Israeli; \q mahali pa mbali kabisa duniani pameona \q jinsi Mungu wetu anavyookoa.
sw.R: Hajasahau upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma kwa watu wa Israeli, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} amezitimiza ahadi {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} kwao. \q Watu walio mahali pa mbali kabisa duniani wameona \q Mungu wetu akituokoa.

es.L: Se ha acordado de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor leal y de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} fidelidad para con la casa de Israel; \q todos los confines de la tierra han visto \q la salvación de nuestro Dios.
es.B: Ha tenido presente {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} fidelidad hacia el pueblo de Israel; \q los lugares más lejanos de la tierra han visto \q cómo salva nuestro Dios.
es.R: No se ha olvidado de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel por el pueblo de Israel, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha cumplido {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} promesas. \q La gente de los lugares más lejanos de la tierra ha visto \q cómo nuestro Dios nos salva.

vi.L: Ngài đã nhớ đến tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và sự thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đối với nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên; \q mọi nơi tận cùng trái đất đã thấy \q sự cứu rỗi của Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta.
vi.B: Ngài đã ghi nhớ tình yêu thương thành tín và sự thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đối với dân Y-sơ-ra-ên; \q những nơi xa xôi nhất của trái đất đã thấy \q Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta giải cứu thế nào.
vi.R: Ngài không quên tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dành cho dân Y-sơ-ra-ên, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã giữ lời hứa với họ. \q Người ở những nơi xa xôi nhất trên đất đã thấy \q Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta giải cứu chúng ta.

ko.L: 그분께서 이스라엘 집에 베푸신 그분의 한결같은 사랑과 그분의 신실하심을 기억하셨으니, \q 땅의 모든 끝이 \q 우리 하나님의 구원을 보았다.
ko.B: 그분께서 이스라엘 백성에게 보이신 한결같은 사랑과 신실하심을 잊지 않으셨으니, \q 땅의 가장 먼 곳까지 \q 우리 하나님께서 구원하시는 것을 보았다.
ko.R: 그분께서는 이스라엘 백성을 향한 변함없는 사랑을 잊지 않으셨고, 그들에게 하신 약속을 지키셨다. \q 땅의 가장 먼 곳에 사는 사람들도 \q 우리 하나님께서 우리를 구원하시는 것을 보았다.

pt.L: Ele se lembrou do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal e da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} fidelidade à casa de Israel; \q viram todos os confins da terra \q a salvação do nosso Deus.
pt.B: Ele não se esqueceu do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal e da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} fidelidade para com o povo de Israel; \q os lugares mais distantes da terra viram \q como o nosso Deus salva.
pt.R: Ele não se esqueceu do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor fiel pelo povo de Israel, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} cumpriu as {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} promessas a eles. \q Pessoas dos lugares mais distantes da terra viram \q o nosso Deus nos salvar.

am.L: ለእስራኤል ቤት ጽኑ ፍቅሩንና ታማኝነቱን አሰበ፤ \q የምድር ዳርቻዎች ሁሉ \q የአምላካችንን ማዳን አዩ።
am.B: ለእስራኤል ሕዝብ ያለውን ጽኑ ፍቅሩንና ታማኝነቱን አስታወሰ፤ \q የምድር ዳርቻዎች ሁሉ \q አምላካችን እንዴት እንደሚያድን አዩ።
am.R: ለእስራኤል ሕዝብ ያለውን ጽኑ ፍቅሩን አልረሳም፤ የሰጣቸውንም ተስፋ ጠበቀ። \q በምድር ዳርቻ የሚኖሩ ሰዎች ሁሉ \q አምላካችን እኛን ሲያድን አዩ።

hi.L: उन्होंने इस्राएल के घराने के प्रति अपने अटल प्रेम और अपनी सच्चाई को स्मरण किया है; \q पृथ्वी के सब छोरों ने \q हमारे परमेश्वर का उद्धार देखा है।
hi.B: उन्होंने इस्राएल की प्रजा के प्रति अपने अटल प्रेम और विश्वासयोग्यता को ध्यान में रखा है; \q पृथ्वी के सबसे दूर के स्थानों ने \q देखा है कि हमारे परमेश्वर कैसे उद्धार करते हैं।
hi.R: वे इस्राएल के लोगों के प्रति अपने अटल प्रेम को नहीं भूले, और उन्होंने उनसे किए अपने वादे निभाए हैं। \q पृथ्वी के सबसे दूर के स्थानों के लोगों ने \q हमारे परमेश्वर को हमें बचाते देखा है।

ru.L: Он вспомнил свою неизменную любовь и свою верность к дому Израиля; \q все концы земли увидели \q спасение нашего Бога.
ru.B: Он не забыл свою неизменную любовь и верность к народу Израиля; \q самые дальние края земли увидели, \q как спасает наш Бог.
ru.R: Он не забыл о своей неизменной любви к народу Израиля, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} сдержал данные им обещания. \q Люди в самых дальних краях земли увидели, \q как наш Бог спас нас.

uk.L: Він згадав свою незмінну любов і свою вірність до дому Ізраїля; \q усі кінці землі побачили \q спасіння нашого Бога.
uk.B: Він памʼятав про свою незмінну любов і вірність до народу Ізраїля; \q найдальші краї землі побачили, \q як спасає наш Бог.
uk.R: Він не забув своєї вірної любові до народу Ізраїля і дотримав своїх обіцянок їм. \q Люди в найдальших краях землі побачили, \q як наш Бог рятує нас.

decisions.reason: The word (chesed) is the love that keeps faith, God's commitment to his people that does not give up (5:8).

decisions.choice: remembered: acted on what he had promised
decisions.reason: When God "remembers" his love it means he acts on it, as he remembered his covenant in Egypt (Exodus 2:24).
"All the ends of the earth will see the salvation of our God" is the promise of Isaiah 52:10; here it is sung as done.
As in the earlier psalms, Readable says "faithful love" for chesed.
Readable says what God's faithfulness did.

decisions.choice: se lembrou (L); não se esqueceu (B, R)
decisions.reason: Mary's song echoes this line in Luke 1:54, whose Portuguese says "lembrando-se" (L) and "não se esqueceu" (B), so the psalm uses the same verbs at those levels. The Hebrew has chesed, so "amor leal" stays where Luke's Greek has "misericórdia".

God's hesed (meaning m1) is "अटल प्रेम" at every level, also where the English Readable says "faithful love"; his faithfulness is "सच्चाई" at Literal and "विश्वासयोग्यता" at Balanced, and Readable says what it did, as its English does.

source.text: הָרִ֣יעוּ לַֽ֭יהוָה כָּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ פִּצְח֖וּ וְרַנְּנ֣וּ וְזַמֵּֽרוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Shout to YHWH, all the earth; break forth and sing for joy and make music.

en.L: Shout for joy to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, all the earth; \q break forth and sing for joy and make music.
en.B: Raise a glad shout to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, all the earth; \q burst into joyful song and make music!
en.R: Everyone on earth, shout happily to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! \q Break out in joyful singing and play music!

fr.L: Acclamez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, toute la terre ; \q éclatez, criez de joie et jouez de la musique.
fr.B: Poussez des cris de joie pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, terre entière ; \q éclatez en chants joyeux et faites de la musique !
fr.R: Vous tous qui êtes sur la terre, acclamez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avec bonheur ! \q Mettez-vous à chanter de joie et jouez de la musique !

sw.L: Mpigieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kelele za furaha, dunia yote; \q pazeni sauti mwimbe kwa furaha na kupiga muziki.
sw.B: Mshangilieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, dunia yote; \q angueni nyimbo za furaha na kupiga muziki!
sw.R: Kila mtu duniani, mpigieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kelele za furaha! \q Anzeni kuimba kwa furaha na kupiga muziki!

es.L: {{plural_you:Aclamen|Aclamad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, toda la tierra; \q {{plural_you:prorrumpan|prorrumpid}}, {{plural_you:canten|cantad}} con júbilo y {{plural_you:toquen|tocad}} música.
es.B: {{plural_you:Alcen|Alzad}} un grito de gozo {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, toda la tierra; \q ¡{{plural_you:estallen|estallad}} en cantos de alegría y {{plural_you:toquen|tocad}} música!
es.R: ¡Todos los que viven en la tierra, {{plural_you:griten|gritad}} con alegría {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}! \q ¡{{plural_you:Canten|Cantad}} con gozo y {{plural_you:toquen|tocad}} música!

vi.L: Hãy reo hò cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, hỡi cả trái đất; \q hãy bật lên, reo hát và tấu nhạc.
vi.B: Hỡi cả trái đất, hãy cất tiếng reo mừng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; \q hãy vỡ òa trong tiếng hát vui mừng và tấu nhạc!
vi.R: Hỡi mọi người trên đất, hãy reo hò vui mừng cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! \q Hãy cất tiếng hát vui vẻ và chơi nhạc!

ko.L: 온 땅아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 기뻐 외쳐라. \q 터뜨려라, 기뻐 노래하고 찬송하여라.
ko.B: 온 땅아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 즐거이 외쳐라. \q 기쁨의 노래를 터뜨리며 찬양의 음악을 연주하여라!
ko.R: 땅 위의 모든 사람들아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 기쁘게 외쳐라! \q 기쁜 노래를 터뜨리고 음악을 연주하여라!

pt.L: Gritem de alegria {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, toda a terra; \q irrompam e cantem com alegria e façam música.
pt.B: Ergam um grito alegre {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, toda a terra; \q explodam em cânticos de alegria e façam música!
pt.R: Todos na terra, gritem de alegria para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}! \q Comecem a cantar com alegria e toquem música!

am.L: ምድር ሁሉ፣ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} በደስታ ጩኹ፤ \q ፈንድቁ፤ እልል በሉ፤ ዜማም አሰሙ።
am.B: ምድር ሁሉ፣ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} የደስታ ጩኸት አሰሙ፤ \q በደስታ መዝሙር ፈንድቁ፤ ዜማም አሰሙ!
am.R: በምድር ያላችሁ ሁሉ፣ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} በደስታ ጩኹ! \q በደስታ ዘምሩ፤ በዜማ ዕቃም ተጫወቱ!

hi.L: हे सारी पृथ्वी, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का जयजयकार करो; \q उमंग से भर जाओ और आनंद से गाओ और भजन गाओ।
hi.B: हे सारी पृथ्वी, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए आनंद से जयजयकार करो; \q आनंद के गीत गा उठो और संगीत बजाओ!
hi.R: पृथ्वी के सब लोगो, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का ख़ुशी से जयजयकार करो! \q आनंद से गा उठो और संगीत बजाओ!

ru.L: Радостно кричите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, вся земля; \q разразитесь ликованием, пойте и играйте.
ru.B: Поднимите радостный клич {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, вся земля; \q запойте радостную песнь и играйте!
ru.R: Все люди на земле, радостно кричите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}! \q Запойте радостную песню и играйте музыку!

uk.L: Радісно викликуйте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, уся земле; \q вибухніть, і радісно співайте, і грайте.
uk.B: Здійміть радісний клич {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, уся земле; \q залийтеся радісною піснею й грайте!
uk.R: Усі на землі, радісно вигукуйте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}! \q Співайте з радістю й грайте музику!

decisions.choice: shout: the cry that greets a king
decisions.reason: The verb (heria') is to raise a loud shout, as when a king is welcomed (Numbers 23:21; 1 Samuel 10:24).
The verb (zimmer) is to make music with voice and instrument; verses 5-6 name the instruments.

source.text: זַמְּר֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה בְּכִנּ֑וֹר בְּ֝כִנּ֗וֹר וְק֣וֹל זִמְרָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Make music to YHWH with [the] lyre, with [the] lyre and [the] sound of melody.

en.L: Make music to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} with the lyre, \q with the lyre and the sound of song.
en.B: Make music for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} on the lyre, \q the lyre and the voice of song!
en.R: Play music for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} on the harp! \q Play the harp and sing songs to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}!

fr.L: Jouez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} sur la lyre, \q sur la lyre et au son du chant.
fr.B: Faites de la musique {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} sur la lyre, \q la lyre et la voix du chant !
fr.R: Jouez de la harpe {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ! \q Jouez de la harpe et chantez pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} !

sw.L: Mpigieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} muziki kwa kinubi, \q kwa kinubi na sauti ya wimbo.
sw.B: Mpigieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} muziki kwa kinubi, \q kinubi na sauti ya wimbo!
sw.R: Mpigieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} muziki kwa kinubi! \q Pigeni kinubi na kumwimbia nyimbo!

es.L: {{plural_you:Toquen|Tocad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} con la lira, \q con la lira y el son del canto.
es.B: {{plural_you:Toquen|Tocad}} música {{divine_name:para el SEÑOR|para Yahvé}} con la lira, \q ¡con la lira y la voz del canto!
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Toquen|Tocad}} el arpa {{divine_name:para el SEÑOR|para Yahvé}}! \q ¡{{plural_you:Toquen|Tocad}} el arpa y {{plural_you:cántenle|cantadle}} canciones!

vi.L: Hãy tấu nhạc cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} bằng đàn lia, \q bằng đàn lia và tiếng ca hát.
vi.B: Hãy tấu nhạc cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} trên đàn lia, \q với đàn lia và tiếng hát!
vi.R: Hãy chơi đàn hạc cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! \q Hãy gảy đàn hạc và hát những bài ca cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}!

ko.B: 수금을 타며 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 찬양하여라. \q 수금과 노랫소리로 찬양하여라!
ko.R: 수금을 타며 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찬양하여라! \q 수금을 연주하며 그분께 노래를 불러라!

pt.L: Façam música {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} com a lira, \q com a lira e o som do canto.
pt.B: Façam música para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} na lira, \q na lira e com a voz do canto!
pt.R: Toquem música para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} na harpa! \q Toquem a harpa e cantem canções para {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}!

am.R: {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} በበገና ተጫወቱ! \q በገና እየደረደራችሁ መዝሙር ዘምሩለት!

hi.L: वीणा के साथ {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का भजन गाओ, \q वीणा और गीत के स्वर के साथ।
hi.B: वीणा पर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए संगीत बजाओ, \q वीणा और गीत की आवाज़ के साथ!
hi.R: वीणा पर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए संगीत बजाओ! \q वीणा बजाओ और उनके लिए गीत गाओ!

ru.L: Играйте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}} на лире, \q на лире и со звуком песни.
ru.B: Играйте для {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} на лире, \q на лире, и пусть звучит песня!
ru.R: Играйте для {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} на арфе! \q Играйте на арфе и пойте {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}} песни!

uk.L: Грайте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}} на лірі, \q на лірі й зі звуком пісні.
uk.B: Грайте для {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} на лірі, \q на лірі й співайте голосом!
uk.R: Грайте для {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} на арфі! \q Грайте на арфі й співайте {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}} пісні!

decisions.reason: The kinnor was a hand-held stringed instrument, played by David (1 Samuel 16:23).
The word (zimrah) is a song or tune, sung or played.
Readable uses the more familiar name for a stringed instrument.
Readable says to whom the songs are sung.
The English Readable says "harp" for a common word; "수금" is the word Korean readers know for this small stringed instrument (meaning decision m1) and is plain enough for Readable.

The kinnor (meaning m1) is "वीणा", as in 92:4 and 1 Chronicles 15-16 in this translation. The English Readable says "harp" as the more familiar word, but in Hindi "वीणा" is itself the familiar name of a stringed instrument, so Readable keeps it.

source.text: בַּ֭חֲצֹ֣צְרוֹת וְק֣וֹל שׁוֹפָ֑ר הָ֝רִ֗יעוּ לִפְנֵ֤י׀הַמֶּ֬לֶךְ יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: With trumpets and [the] sound of [the] horn shout before the King, YHWH.

en.L: With trumpets and the sound of the ram's horn \q shout for joy before the King, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: With trumpets and the ram's horn sounding, \q lift a glad shout before the King, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Blow the trumpets and the ram's horn! \q Shout for joy to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the King!

fr.L: Avec les trompettes et le son du cor, \q poussez des cris de joie devant le Roi, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Au son des trompettes et du cor, \q lancez une clameur joyeuse devant le Roi, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Sonnez des trompettes et du cor ! \q Criez de joie pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Roi !

sw.L: Kwa tarumbeta na sauti ya baragumu \q pigeni kelele za furaha mbele ya Mfalme, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Tarumbeta na baragumu zikilia, \q pazeni kelele za furaha mbele ya Mfalme, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Pigeni tarumbeta na baragumu! \q Mpigieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mfalme, kelele za furaha!

es.L: Con trompetas y el sonido del cuerno de carnero \q {{plural_you:aclamen|aclamad}} delante del Rey, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Al son de las trompetas y del cuerno de carnero, \q {{plural_you:alcen|alzad}} un grito de gozo ante el Rey, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Toquen|Tocad}} las trompetas y el cuerno de carnero! \q ¡{{plural_you:Griten|Gritad}} de alegría {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, el Rey!

vi.L: Với kèn và tiếng tù và bằng sừng chiên đực, \q hãy reo hò trước mặt Vua, là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Với tiếng kèn trôm-pét và tiếng tù và vang lên, \q hãy reo mừng trước mặt Vua, là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Hãy thổi kèn và tù và! \q Hãy reo hò vui mừng cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, là Vua!

ko.L: 나팔과 뿔나팔 소리로 \q 왕이신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 기뻐 외쳐라.
ko.B: 나팔과 뿔나팔을 울리며 \q 왕이신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 즐거이 외쳐라.
ko.R: 나팔과 뿔나팔을 불어라! \q 왕이신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 기뻐 외쳐라!

pt.L: Com trombetas e o som do chifre de carneiro \q gritem de alegria diante do Rei, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.B: Ao som das trombetas e do chifre de carneiro, \q ergam um grito alegre diante do Rei, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.R: Toquem as trombetas e o chifre de carneiro! \q Gritem de alegria para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Rei!

am.L: በመለከቶችና በቀንድ መለከት ድምፅ \q ንጉሥ በሆነው {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ፊት በደስታ ጩኹ።
am.B: መለከቶችና የቀንድ መለከት እየተነፉ \q ንጉሥ በሆነው {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ፊት የደስታ ጩኸት አሰሙ።
am.R: መለከቶችንና የቀንድ መለከትን ንፉ! \q ንጉሥ ለሆነው {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} በደስታ እልል በሉ!

hi.L: तुरहियों और नरसिंगे के शब्द के साथ \q राजा {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के सामने जयजयकार करो।
hi.B: तुरहियाँ और नरसिंगा बजाते हुए \q राजा {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के सामने आनंद से जयजयकार करो।
hi.R: तुरहियाँ और नरसिंगा फूँको! \q राजा {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का आनंद से जयजयकार करो!

ru.L: С трубами и звуком бараньего рога \q восклицайте перед Царём, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Яхве}}.
ru.B: Под звуки труб и бараньего рога \q поднимите радостный клич перед Царём, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Трубите в трубы и в бараний рог! \q Радостно кричите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, Царю!

uk.L: Із сурмами і звуком рогу \q радісно викликуйте перед Царем, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Ягве}}.
uk.B: Під звуки сурм і рогу \q здійміть радісний клич перед Царем, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Ягве}}.
uk.R: Сурміть у сурми й ріг! \q Радісно вигукуйте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, Цареві!

decisions.choice: trumpets and horn: the sounds of a king's crowning
decisions.reason: The trumpets (chatsotserot) were metal, blown by priests (Numbers 10:2); the horn (shofar) was a ram's horn. The horn was blown when a king was crowned (1 Kings 1:39).
The LORD is hailed as King, the theme of Psalms 93-99.
The shofar is a ram's horn trumpet. French "cor" is the plain word for a horn blown as a signal; the English says "the ram's horn".

decisions.choice: "baragumu" for the ram's horn (shofar), "tarumbeta" for the trumpets
decisions.reason: "Baragumu" is the Swahili horn blown to call people together, the nearest everyday word for the shofar, and it keeps the two instruments apart.

decisions.choice: trumpets (ḥatsotsrot) "መለከቶች"; the ram's horn (shofar) "የቀንድ መለከት" at every level
decisions.reason: The silver trumpets keep the word of Numbers 10 on main. Where both instruments stand in one line the shofar is kept apart as "የቀንድ መለከት" at every level, as the Pentateuch has it.

The metal trumpets and the ram's horn (meaning m1) are "तुरही" and "नरसिंगा", as in 1 Chronicles 15:28 in this translation. The LORD is hailed as King (meaning m2): Hindi puts the title first, "राजा {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}", as it does with a king's name.

source.text: יִרְעַ֣ם הַ֭יָּם וּמְלֹא֑וֹ תֵּ֝בֵ֗ל וְיֹ֣שְׁבֵי בָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Let the sea thunder and its fullness, [the] world and those who dwell in it.

en.L: Let the sea thunder, and its fullness, \q the world and those who dwell in it.
en.B: Let the sea and everything in it thunder, \q the world and everyone living there.
en.R: Let the sea and every creature in it roar! \q Let the world and everyone who lives in it join in!

fr.L: Que gronde la mer et ce qui la remplit, \q le monde et ceux qui l’habitent.
fr.B: Que la mer gronde avec tout ce qu’elle contient, \q le monde et tous ceux qui y vivent.
fr.R: Que la mer et tous les animaux qui y vivent fassent entendre leur bruit ! \q Que le monde et tous ceux qui l’habitent se joignent à eux !

sw.L: Bahari na ivume, na vyote vilivyomo, \q ulimwengu na wale wakaao ndani yake.
sw.B: Bahari na kila kitu kilichomo na kivume, \q ulimwengu na wote wanaoishi humo.
sw.R: Bahari na kila kiumbe kilichomo na kivume! \q Ulimwengu na kila mtu anayeishi ndani yake na waungane nao!

es.L: Brame el mar y lo que lo llena, \q el mundo y los que habitan en él.
es.B: Que brame el mar con todo lo que hay en él, \q el mundo y todos los que viven allí.
es.R: ¡Que rujan el mar y todas sus criaturas! \q ¡Que se unan el mundo y todos los que viven en él!

vi.L: Hãy để biển gầm vang, cùng muôn vật đầy dẫy trong đó, \q thế gian và những người ở trong đó.
vi.B: Nguyện biển cả và mọi vật trong đó gầm vang, \q thế gian và mọi người sống trên đó.
vi.R: Hỡi biển cả và mọi sinh vật trong biển, hãy gầm vang! \q Hỡi thế giới và mọi người sống trên đó, hãy cùng hòa theo!

ko.L: 바다와 그 안에 가득한 것, \q 세상과 그 안에 사는 이들은 우렁차게 외쳐라.
ko.B: 바다와 그 안의 모든 것은 우렁차게 외치고, \q 세상과 그 안에 사는 모든 이들도 그리하여라.
ko.R: 바다와 그 안의 모든 생물들아, 크게 외쳐라! \q 세상과 그 안에 사는 모든 사람들아, 함께 외쳐라!

pt.L: Troveje o mar e a sua plenitude, \q o mundo e os que nele habitam.
pt.B: Que o mar troveje com tudo o que vive nele, \q o mundo e todos os que moram nele.
pt.R: Que o mar e todos os seres que vivem nele rujam! \q Que o mundo e todos os que vivem nele se juntem a eles!

am.L: ባሕርና ሞላዋ ይንጎድጓድ፤ \q ዓለምና በእርሷ የሚኖሩ።
am.B: ባሕርና በውስጡ የሚኖር ሁሉ ይንጎድጓድ፤ \q ዓለምና በእርሷ የሚኖሩ ሁሉ።
am.R: ባሕርና በውስጡ ያሉ ፍጥረታት ሁሉ ይጩኹ! \q ዓለምና በእርሷ የሚኖሩ ሁሉ ይተባበሩ!

hi.L: समुद्र और जो कुछ उसमें भरा है, गरजे, \q जगत और उसके निवासी।
hi.B: समुद्र और उसमें रहनेवाले सब गरजें, \q जगत और उसमें रहनेवाले सब।
hi.R: समुद्र और उसके सब जीव-जंतु गरजें! \q जगत और उसमें रहनेवाले सब लोग भी साथ दें!

ru.L: Пусть шумит море и то, что наполняет его, \q вселенная и живущие в ней.
ru.B: Пусть гремит море со всем, что в нём живёт, \q мир и все его жители.
ru.R: Пусть ревут море и все существа в нём! \q Пусть мир и все, кто живёт в нём, присоединятся!

uk.L: Нехай гримить море і все, що його наповнює, \q світ і ті, хто живе в ньому.
uk.B: Нехай гримить море і все, що в ньому, \q світ і всі, хто там живе.
uk.R: Нехай ревуть море і кожне створіння в ньому! \q Нехай світ і всі, хто в ньому живе, приєднаються!

decisions.reason: The first line repeats 96:11; "the world and those who dwell in it" is from 24:1.
Readable repeats the verb for the second line, which the Hebrew leaves understood.

The first line repeats Psalm 96:11 (m1), so each level keeps its Portuguese ("troveje o mar e a sua plenitude", "que o mar troveje com tudo o que vive nele", "Que o mar e todos os seres que vivem nele rujam!").

decisions.choice: the first line as 1 Chronicles 16:32 on main ("ባሕርና ሞላዋ ይንጎድጓድ", Balanced "ባሕርና በውስጡ የሚኖር ሁሉ ይንጎድጓድ", Readable "… ይጩኹ")
decisions.reason: The meaning decision notes that the line repeats 96:11, which is also 1 Chronicles 16:32; the Hebrew is the same, so the Amharic keeps the wording already drafted there.
The first line repeats Psalm 96:11 (meaning m1), so it keeps the Hindi of that verse (and of 1 Chronicles 16:32) at each level.
The first line is the Hebrew of Psalm 96:11b and 1 Chronicles 16:32 (m1), so each level keeps that wording.

records.literal_gloss: [The] rivers — let them clap a hand; together [the] mountains — let them sing for joy

en.L: Let the rivers clap [their] hands; \q together let the mountains sing for joy
en.B: May the rivers clap their hands, \q and the mountains all sing for joy together,
en.R: Let the rivers clap for joy, \q and let all the mountains sing together.

fr.L: Que les fleuves battent des mains ; \q que les montagnes ensemble crient de joie
fr.B: Que les fleuves applaudissent, \q et que les montagnes chantent toutes ensemble de joie,
fr.R: Que les fleuves applaudissent de joie, \q et que toutes les montagnes chantent ensemble.

sw.L: Mito na ipige makofi; \q milima na iimbe kwa furaha pamoja
sw.B: Mito na ipige makofi, \q na milima yote iimbe kwa furaha pamoja,
sw.R: Mito na ipige makofi kwa furaha, \q na milima yote iimbe pamoja.

es.L: Los ríos batan [las] manos; \q a una los montes canten con júbilo
es.B: Que los ríos aplaudan, \q y que todos los montes canten juntos de alegría,
es.R: Que los ríos aplaudan de alegría, \q y que todos los montes canten juntos.

vi.L: Hãy để các sông vỗ tay; \q hãy để núi non cùng nhau reo hát
vi.B: Nguyện các sông vỗ tay, \q và núi non cùng nhau reo hát vui mừng,
vi.R: Hỡi các dòng sông, hãy vỗ tay vui mừng, \q và hỡi núi non, hãy cùng nhau ca hát.

ko.L: 강들은 손뼉을 쳐라. \q 산들은 함께 기뻐 노래하여라.
ko.B: 강들은 손뼉을 치고, \q 산들은 모두 함께 기뻐 노래하여라.
ko.R: 강들아, 기뻐서 손뼉을 쳐라. \q 모든 산들아, 함께 노래하여라.

pt.L: Os rios batam palmas; \q juntos os montes cantem de alegria
pt.B: Que os rios batam palmas, \q e os montes todos juntos cantem de alegria,
pt.R: Que os rios batam palmas de alegria, \q e que todos os montes cantem juntos.

am.L: ወንዞች እጅ ያጨብጭቡ፤ \q ተራሮችም በአንድነት እልል ይበሉ
am.B: ወንዞች እጆቻቸውን ያጨብጭቡ፤ \q ተራሮችም ሁሉ በአንድነት በደስታ ይዘምሩ፣
am.R: ወንዞች በደስታ ያጨብጭቡ፤ \q ተራሮችም ሁሉ በአንድነት ይዘምሩ።

hi.L: नदियाँ ताली बजाएँ; \q पहाड़ मिलकर जयजयकार करें
hi.B: नदियाँ अपने हाथों से ताली बजाएँ, \q और सब पहाड़ एक साथ आनंद से गाएँ,
hi.R: नदियाँ आनंद से ताली बजाएँ, \q और सब पहाड़ मिलकर गाएँ।

ru.L: Пусть реки хлопают [в] ладоши; \q пусть все вместе горы поют от радости
ru.B: Пусть реки бьют в ладоши, \q и горы все вместе поют от радости,
ru.R: Пусть реки хлопают от радости, \q и пусть все горы поют вместе.

uk.L: Нехай ріки плещуть [у] долоні; \q разом нехай гори радісно співають
uk.B: Нехай ріки плещуть у долоні, \q і гори разом радісно співають,
uk.R: Нехай ріки плещуть від радості, \q і нехай усі гори співають разом.

decisions.choice: clap hands: applause for a king
decisions.reason: Clapping greeted a new king (2 Kings 11:12; 47:2). The rivers and mountains are pictured joining the welcome, as in Isaiah 55:12.

source.text: לִֽפְֽנֵי־יְהוָ֗ה כִּ֥י בָא֮ לִשְׁפֹּ֪ט הָ֫אָ֥רֶץ יִשְׁפֹּֽט־תֵּבֵ֥ל בְּצֶ֑דֶק וְ֝עַמִּ֗ים בְּמֵישָׁרִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: before YHWH, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge [the] world with righteousness and [the] peoples with uprightness.

en.L: before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} comes to judge the earth. \q He will judge the world with righteousness, \q and the peoples with uprightness.
en.B: in the presence of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is on the way to judge the earth. \q He will govern the world rightly \q and the peoples with fairness.
en.R: Let them sing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is coming to judge the earth. \q He will rule the world with justice \q and treat all people fairly.

fr.L: devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vient juger la terre. \q Il jugera le monde avec justice, \q et les peuples avec droiture.
fr.B: devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est en chemin pour juger la terre. \q Il gouvernera le monde avec justice \q et les peuples avec équité.
fr.R: Qu’ils chantent pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, parce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vient juger la terre. \q Il gouvernera le monde avec justice \q et traitera tous les gens de façon juste.

sw.L: mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana anakuja kuihukumu nchi. \q Atauhukumu ulimwengu kwa haki, \q na mataifa kwa unyofu.
sw.B: mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana yuko njiani kuja kuihukumu nchi. \q Atautawala ulimwengu kwa haki \q na mataifa kwa usawa.
sw.R: Na wamwimbie {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa sababu anakuja kuihukumu dunia. \q Atautawala ulimwengu kwa haki \q na kuwatendea watu wote kwa usawa.

es.L: delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, porque viene a juzgar la tierra. \q Juzgará al mundo con justicia, \q y a los pueblos con rectitud.
es.B: en la presencia {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} está en camino para juzgar la tierra. \q Gobernará al mundo con rectitud \q y a los pueblos con equidad.
es.R: Que le canten {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} viene a juzgar la tierra. \q Gobernará el mundo con justicia \q y tratará a todos con equidad.

vi.L: trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến để xét xử trái đất. \q Ngài sẽ xét xử thế gian bằng sự công chính, \q và các dân bằng sự ngay thẳng.
vi.B: trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đang đến để xét xử trái đất. \q Ngài sẽ cai quản thế gian cách công chính \q và các dân cách công bằng.
vi.R: Hãy hát cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đang đến để xét xử trái đất. \q Ngài sẽ cai trị thế giới cách công bằng \q và đối xử với mọi người cách ngay thẳng.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 [그리하여라]. 그분께서 땅을 심판하러 오신다. \q 그분께서 의로 세상을 심판하시고, \q 공정하게 백성들을 [심판하실 것이다].
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 그리하여라. 그분께서 땅을 심판하러 오고 계신다. \q 그분께서 세상을 바르게 다스리시고, \q 백성들을 공정하게 다스리실 것이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 노래하여라. 그분께서 땅을 심판하러 오신다. \q 그분께서 정의로 세상을 다스리실 것이다. \q 모든 사람을 공정하게 대하실 것이다.

pt.L: diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} vem para julgar a terra. \q Ele julgará o mundo com justiça, \q e os povos com retidão.
pt.B: na presença {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, pois {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} está a caminho para julgar a terra. \q Ele governará o mundo com justiça \q e os povos com retidão.
pt.R: Que eles cantem para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} está vindo para julgar a terra. \q Ele vai governar o mundo com justiça \q e tratar todas as pessoas de forma justa.

am.L: {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ፊት፤ በምድር ላይ ሊፈርድ ይመጣልና። \q ዓለምን በጽድቅ ይፈርዳል፤ \q ሕዝቦችንም በቅንነት።
am.B: {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ፊት፤ በምድር ላይ ሊፈርድ በመምጣት ላይ ነውና። \q ዓለምን በትክክል ያስተዳድራል፤ \q ሕዝቦችንም በቅን ፍርድ።
am.R: {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ይዘምሩ፤ ምክንያቱም በምድር ላይ ሊፈርድ ይመጣል። \q ዓለምን በፍትሕ ይገዛል፤ \q ሰዎችንም ሁሉ በቅንነት ይዳኛል።

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के सामने, क्योंकि वे पृथ्वी का न्याय करने आते हैं। \q वे धार्मिकता से जगत का न्याय करेंगे, \q और सीधाई से देश-देश के लोगों का।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की उपस्थिति में, क्योंकि वे पृथ्वी का न्याय करने आ रहे हैं। \q वे जगत पर धार्मिकता से शासन करेंगे \q और देश-देश के लोगों पर निष्पक्षता से।
hi.R: वे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए गाएँ, क्योंकि वे पृथ्वी का न्याय करने आ रहे हैं। \q वे जगत पर न्याय से राज्य करेंगे \q और सब लोगों के साथ निष्पक्षता से व्यवहार करेंगे।

ru.L: перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Яхве}}, потому что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} идёт судить землю. \q Он будет судить вселенную по праведности \q и племена — по правоте.
ru.B: перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Яхве}}, ведь {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} уже в пути, чтобы судить землю. \q Он установит справедливость в мире \q и будет честно судить племена.
ru.R: Пусть они поют {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, потому что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} идёт судить землю. \q Он будет править миром справедливо \q и поступать со всеми людьми честно.

uk.L: перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Ягве}}, бо {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} іде судити землю. \q Він судитиме світ у праведності \q і народи — справедливо.
uk.B: перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Ягве}}, бо {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} уже в дорозі, щоб судити землю. \q Він правитиме світом праведно \q і народами — чесно.
uk.R: Нехай вони співають {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, бо {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} іде судити землю. \q Він правитиме світом справедливо \q і ставитиметься до всіх людей чесно.
